Changelog

Released builds across the original, Live, Dev and loader channels, newest first.

Dev versions are from Shew’s repository, not Live releases. Merge notices show when changes reach Live or when Dev catches up with Live.

Only published releases and tagged builds are shown. Unconfirmed source versions and planned builds are excluded. Dates use UTC.

About this history

Dates use UTC. When a publication date is unavailable, the preserved tag or its build commit supplies the date instead. Source links accompany each entry.

Credits use human Git authors and recorded co-authors across each version’s changes, with aliases combined. Release-only contributions are marked. GitHub profiles are linked where verified; other author names are retained without guessing a profile.

v2.14.8 Live

2026-11-11

Contributors: Ferlieloi

Changed

  • Compact challenge counters fit in one header row on patched games. Turning compact mode off restores their saved height.
  • A refactor made the mod download a little smaller and reduced background work in the header and mod interface.

Fixed

  • Remove header gap keeps the tabs in place when challenges start or end.
  • Auto-Sing validates strategies more thoroughly. If a strategy fails to save, its draft stays open and the existing strategy list stays intact.

2026-11-11

Contributors: Ferlieloi

Added

2026-11-09

Added

v2.14.7c-dev2 Dev version

2026-11-05

Contributors: maenhiir

Added

  • AutoSing setting Record step timings, off by default: a window beside the run panel lists each step’s runs, time, share and wait, sortable, with Copy for a spreadsheet.
  • Perks search field above the Perks / Penalties lists, on by default: matching perks are listed as compact cards, with 10 clickable words; matches the game’s language, ignoring case and accents.
  • Singularity count module: a click opens an Elevator popover (target, Teleport, toggles and where the next singularity goes), with a header setting on by default; Teleport is refused while AutoSing runs.

Changed

  • AutoSing run panel: Gained shows the ants’ share of the run’s quarks, and C15 is the geometric mean.
  • AutoSing Ambrosia slot settings have shorter labels and an Antiquities icon marking pre- and post-AOAG slots.
  • The AutoSing window stacks like the other mod windows.
  • Challenge progress module: bigger text when one to three challenges are shown.
  • Heater results window about 120 px narrower, with shortened Ambrosia costs (exact value in the tooltip) and compact slots.
  • Settings reorganised: a QoL page grouped by game tab, GDS at its top and the timed save export at its bottom, the UI page split in three; saved values are kept. Shorter setting names.
  • Input settings renamed Repeat hover (hold left Shift) and Auto click (hold left Ctrl); Skip risky buttons sits under Auto click.
  • Settings subtabs stay visible while scrolling on one row; fields sit on their label’s line; the Hidden dialogs and Hide vanilla tabs lists can be resized.
  • Timed save export shows only its switch while off, and a folder line with the folder’s name and a button to forget it.
  • The mod panel opens smaller (425x350), resizes down to 300x150, has softer tab colours and is less transparent.
  • Tools tab: shorter descriptions, Mod data in the backup, calculation results with 3 decimals and small values in scientific notation.
  • Game data refreshes are lighter: talisman levels are read from the game (about 50-80 ms saved per refresh).

Removed

  • Debug tab removed from player builds.

Fixed

  • Bookmarklet AutoSing: Max C11-14 no longer stalls once maxed, each singularity goes to AutoSing’s target instead of the saved Elevator target, and Remember last used subtab no longer stops a run right after starting.

Notes

  • Steam: no re-patch needed.
Sources

v2.14.7c-dev1 Dev version

2026-11-04

Contributors: maenhiir, Ferlieloi

Live → Dev Includes changes through v2.14.7c

Added

  • AutoSing setting Keep the PC awake, on by default: the screen stays on and the PC does not sleep while AutoSing runs; on Steam also when minimized, covered or locked.
  • New Auto-Sing players’ guide.
  • Corruption module setting Level controls in the module, on by default: size M adds the next level between ‹ and ›, size L also 0, Max, the cleanse and Auto-climb; Shift steps by 10 and the number can be typed.
  • Tools tab: Mod Website button.

Changed

  • AutoSing keeps its speed in a hidden tab (about 6 s per singularity instead of 15 s when measured).
  • AutoSing’s Don’t switch ambrosia loadouts can be changed during a run; turning it off is refused while a slot is None.
  • Heater: Heat with 1, 2 or 3 workers replaces the Faster heat checkbox, 3 by default; machines under 8 GB or 4 threads keep one.
  • Heater H rows showing Never are dimmed; the Inputs window’s Active Branches becomes Loadouts to heat, with a compact right column and wider slot dropdowns.
  • Sync All Loadout Settings also sets the timed export’s loadout to the Quarks slot, or None without one.
  • Heater, Hepteract Distributor, Dev tools and Challenges help tooltips use the mod’s own tooltip; Import and Copy open on the left when there is no room on the right.
  • The corruption header’s < and > get a coloured frame on hover.
  • Notifications share one top-centre column of 3 that fits its text; hover pauses one and a click dismisses it. Hidden dialogs shown as notifications get their own bottom-left column.
  • The mod’s startup steps (version check, patch warning, offline popup close) run about 7 s sooner.
  • GQ Distributor opens from a Distributor button above the upgrade box and remembers open or closed; the hide-maxed settings are renamed Keep maxed GQ / Octeract upgrades hidden.

Removed

  • Removed the Cycle BUY button and its setting.

Fixed

  • Saves and exports no longer fail once Ambrosia bars fill more than about 1000 times per second; a failed autosave no longer stops autosaving until reload (Tampermonkey and Steam).
  • A NaN Heater input stops the heat at once and names the field, instead of ending in a memory limit error.
  • After the game’s colour update, the Platonic upgrade tooltip, Fix Exalt Bug and bookmarklet AutoSing’s stage reading work again.
  • Hepteract Distributor: with partly filled meters a partial step now ends the plan, and an expansion paid back to the unit no longer stops a run with The game did not craft; its minimize button moved to the top left.
  • Game data matches the game for the Infinite Ascent rune’s unlock, first-five rune effectiveness, rune level at an exact EXP, maxed Octeract upgrades and Red accumulator level 10.

Notes

  • Steam: re-patch once.

Published release · Git tag · Release/build commit

v2.14.7 Live

2026-10-30

Contributors: maenhiir, Ferlieloi

Dev → Live Includes changes through v2.14.6a-dev4

Added

  • Added a header edit pencil beside the mod icon; it and Settings → UI → Edit game header open editing immediately.
  • Added an option to hide the Ambrosia loadout module’s bar icon.
  • The browser mod also runs at pseudo-corp.github.io/SynergismOfficial.
  • The corruption-level header module shows the next ascension’s level and opens cleanse, level, auto-climb and cleanse-to-highest controls; it can remain visible before Challenge 11.
  • Added a Challenge progress header module for nested challenges, with one-line or multi-line layout, completions/requirements and an optional CØ display.
  • Added optional minibars borders; very small minibars have no inter-bar gap.
  • Remember last used subtab supports the corruption Stats, Tokens and Auto Ascension tabs and Settings → Messages, without missing-subview warnings.
  • Added a desktop Grid width slider in header edit settings, with a reset to the game’s original width.
  • Ambrosia loadout slots can fit one grid-cell line, use automation-button sizing and follow cell alignment; controls are grouped under Ambrosia loadouts.
  • Added Don’t switch Ambrosia loadouts for AutoSing, preserving bar progress and allowing unassigned slots.
  • Heater can use two workers in parallel, on by default on suitable computers; low-memory or low-thread systems keep one. Obtainium, Offerings, Luck and Purple searches are also faster.
  • Added the combined Obt + Off Heater build, its optional slower branch and AutoSing Sync Settings choices.
  • Heater remembers active branches, enables a branch when its type is assigned to a slot, and adds controls to select loadout-order branches, all branches or none.
  • The actions editor shows only relevant fields and adds live validation, Undo/Redo, Duplicate, jump links, loop marks, drag auto-scroll, matching log step numbers, action IDs and colored labels.
  • AutoSing Advanced settings gain Reset to default; challenge timers cannot be set to zero, and the timer window shows patch status with details.
  • Added a Coins in C15 Heater build that simulates Challenge 15 from any game-data export, without needing to export inside C15.
  • Added Long press to edit in header settings, with pencil and panel-button access available when the gesture is disabled.

Changed

  • Heater Cube/Hyperflux voucher merging is faster at high budgets.
  • AutoSing supports game 4.4.0’s single corruption level. Explicit Set corruption level steps replace named corruption loadouts and phase levels; the Ascend immediately checkbox can apply a level now or defer it to the next ascension.
  • Saved/imported strategies are converted for the new corruption actions. Older custom strategies require their corruption levels to be retuned after conversion to zero; temporary bundled strategies replace the old defaults.
  • Calculations follow game 4.4.0: corruption levels/effects/salvage and full challenge completions; Cube Bank and Corruption Lines replace ascension-score cube rates, and Corruption Score Multiplier is removed.
  • Corruption viscosity, cube unlock levels and cube rates follow the game’s October 26 balancing.
  • PseudoCoin upgrades and Quark bonuses come directly from the game, immediately reflecting in-game purchases and removing extra account requests.
  • The strategy editor supports simultaneous strategy and actions windows. Phase end conditions and step counts sit on phase rows, with inline phase insertion and unsaved-change warnings.
  • Patched players get live game-data reads, including talisman fragments, without repeated Save clicks. GDS is always active there and its toggle is shown only to bookmarklet players.
  • Settings controls, title bars and panel tabs are more compact; the challenge module has its [HS] name in edit mode and the Info disclaimer is clearer.
  • Browser loaders try up to three automatic reloads when the game starts before the loader.
  • Heater results use icon headers and clearer Loadout/Actions columns.
  • Challenge progress supports a 1×2 layout with the requirement on a separate line.
  • Header alignment packs visible buttons left or right or distributes them across the center, including in the preview; empty placeholders are removed and buttons can be inserted between existing ones.
  • Header button capacity follows grid width and button size; existing groups wrap while preserving their grouping. Grid width also accepts a typed number.

Removed

  • Removed obsolete Corrup Ants, minus-free-level and phase-reapply actions, and the automatic ascension at phase entry. Corruption targets are actual levels; AoAG still begins after applying level zero.
  • Removed retired corruption-loadout header features, including slot counts, custom icons, level lines and icon cleanse. Hide loadout icons now applies only to Ambrosia.

Fixed

  • AutoSing disables the game’s corruption auto-increase and no longer incorrectly reports an incomplete patch after game 4.4.0.
  • Game’s modules: numbers only persists after reload; header alignment shows unset cells correctly and aligns stacked ascension timers.
  • Campaign tokens come from corruption-token completions, fixing zero tokens in Heater exports and backups.
  • Heater Max Amb + Oct can buy Ambrosia Luck-Cube Hybrid Module I.
  • Heater marks the resource short in unaffordable rows and the resource limiting unmaxed rows; H0–H3 can correctly display Maxed.
  • Heater’s Max Amb + Oct score and cube, Octeract and H result effects include the game’s Platonic Tau power.
  • Platonic upgrade timers say to craft Abyss Hepteracts when needed and no longer show Ready now during the final 1% of the wait.
  • Heater Cubes and H0–H3 no longer omit affordable Quark-Luck, Luck4, Brick and Free Luck upgrades.
  • Heater singularity-reducer relief no longer applies the Global Speed singularity penalty twice; Max SR rows show cube effects and reducer levels and are Unaffordable when no level fits the budget.
  • Heater’s Active Bells field controls Happy Hour assumptions; all input fields reach the calculation, and Jack of All Trades Level replaces the old checkbox. Inputs are grouped under headings.
  • Strategy editing Cancel restores IF targets; deleting steps preserves jump destinations, IF Wait before values persist and insert buttons no longer remain highlighted. Invalid imports explain their errors.
  • Partly patched games retain AutoSing’s fast paths for the functions that are available.
  • Synthesis upgrade levels follow the game; loading a save no longer emits GDS pause/resume notices, and bookmarklet loadout matching works with GDS off.
  • The panel button brings minimized or covered panels forward; the header pencil stays below tooltips and windows and no longer closes the panel.
  • Calculate components returns the result when a calculation has no component breakdown.
  • Missing optional timing data no longer discards valid Heater results.
  • Updated Demon King (rus) to ascend at the start of its ascension-to-Challenge-13 phase.

Notes

  • This Live release includes the cumulative Dev changes after 2.14.5-dev12 through 2.14.6a-dev4, plus the later Coins in C15, deferred-corruption and header improvements. Notes compare it with Live 2.14.6a.

Fixed

  • Fixed game icons showing beneath custom Ambrosia loadout icons and potion buttons reverting to game text after a language change.

v2.14.6 Live

2026-10-22

Contributors: maenhiir, Ferlieloi

Dev → Live Includes changes through v2.14.5-dev12

Added

  • Added expected Ambrosia, Red Ambrosia and Purple Honey income per hour for the active loadout.
  • Added experimental Purple Honey and Purple Ambrosia Heater builds, using either current reactor routing or jointly optimized routing.
  • Added Auto-dismiss offline popup, on by default; disabling it leaves the progress popup open while the mod loads.
  • Added Always confirm and Don’t show again controls for selected game dialogs, with a shared dialog queue and optional notices.
  • Golden Quark distribution can keep or redistribute skipped upgrades’ shares, stops safely after a failed purchase, and groups skipped upgrades by reason and game name.
  • Added Backup & Restore: one file can contain the game save, mod data, game preferences and logs, with selectable parts to restore.
  • Added Remember last used subtab. AutoSing restores the selected tab and subtab after each singularity; locked tabs leave you on Buildings.
  • Dev-channel players receive new Dev-build and Live-release notices, including on Steam.
  • Heater runs write their summary, optimizer warnings and failure details to the Log tab.
  • Added the Hepteract Distributor: saved ratios divide owned Hepteracts among forge types across ascensions and Auto craft, with optional singularity reducers and in-panel help.
  • Added timed save exports with an optional Ambrosia loadout, a chosen export folder for Steam, and an option to keep only the latest files.
  • The Hepteract Distributor can add Talisman Power to a temporary Ambrosia tree, including when Talisman Power is the only upgrade available.
  • Manual backups also include Heater diagnostic data for bug reports.
  • Hepteract Distributor can reserve a chosen power of ten of owned Hepteracts; ratios compare the equivalent Hepteract value of each balance.
  • Added Keep upgrade levels shown on the tree, on by default and synchronized with the game’s pin control.
  • Added Center quick bars for bookmarklet players using the old quickbar row.
  • Any game image can be a header loadout icon; corruption modules show current and next levels and a cleanse control.
  • Added Keep my header layout when loading a save.
  • Added Best H (P4x4 now) and a star marking the current best H result; Heater shows elapsed heat time and the current worker group.
  • Added the [HS] Header settings block in header edit mode, with visible loadout-slot counts and an option to put the top stats row below currencies and reset buttons.
  • Added 27 calculation tools with option fields, fresh data at every run, named components and totals; calculations are grouped by topic and sorted alphabetically.
  • Header cells gain Left/Center/Right and Top/Center/Bottom alignment, plus full/half-height modules, with separate desktop and mobile settings.
  • Added Edit game header in Settings → UI, header-gap removal, compact challenge text and Octeract icon/unit display options.
  • Ambrosia minibars resize by dragging their edges or corner in edit mode; desktop and mobile sizes are remembered separately.

Changed

  • Heater results explain when to use each loadout; Red Ambrosia results can be sorted.
  • Golden Quark distribution skips maxed, locked or otherwise refused upgrades, redistributes their shares, and reports skipped purchases instead of silently stopping.
  • Ambrosia Quick Import and Heater imports write loadouts directly, including during AutoSing; Auto-Loadout restores the previous slot.
  • The Ambrosia quickbar gives a guessed loadout a silver border and a game-confirmed loadout a rainbow border.
  • Heater results use clearer decimals, names and Purple routing columns; unaffordable choices are unticked and shown in red, including Max Amb + Oct.
  • The quick menu places Start AutoSing below the Heater entries.
  • Purple Heater builds appear among Common Loadouts, and a running heat can be cancelled.
  • Ambrosia, Red Ambrosia and Purple Honey hourly rates refresh every 500 ms with GDS, every 2 seconds without it, and every 10 seconds during AutoSing.
  • AutoSing labels correctly state S216+; Golden Quark ratios are centered and shown with at most two decimal places.
  • Related settings can appear indented under their parent; AutoSing strategy buttons have their own group, panel buttons are wider and the AutoSing timer has an opaque background.
  • Updated the bundled Demon King (rus) strategy to v1.3.
  • Automation, Ambrosia minibars and hourly income become movable game-header modules; bookmarklet players keep their old row.
  • The game’s Ambrosia loadout module replaces the old quickbar and receives active/guessed borders; corruption and event quickbars give way to game-header controls.
  • Ambrosia minibars read live game data, and less frequent save captures reduce GDS CPU usage.
  • Backup filenames include the Exalt and highest singularity; log messages use clearer colors and timestamps.
  • Corruption controls use the game’s new cleanse button; the Quickbars quick-menu entry is removed because those bars now live in the header.

Removed

  • Removed outdated corruption reference tables.
  • Removed obsolete Display shop item names, IconSet Caching and Test patch settings; failed setting actions now appear in the Log tab.

Fixed

  • Corrected Hepteract costs using the game’s double-capacity unlock; the manual double-capacity setting is no longer needed.
  • Fixed missing Heater input icons, overflowing Ambrosia buttons and upgrade-level tooltips; restored and renamed the game’s Saved indicator while GDS is running.
  • AutoSing, automation controls, Hepteract confirmation toggles, Ambrosia loadout modes and imports work across game languages and after language switches.
  • The Auto-Challenge quickbar shows its state before the Challenges tab has been visited.
  • Fixed browser loading when the offline popup closes early and Steam AutoSing starting in slow mode on its first run; startup no longer visibly switches tabs.
  • Persistent Ambrosia upgrade levels refresh after tree changes and imports, clearing stale dimmed or maxed styles.
  • The active Ambrosia loadout follows the game’s own marker, and Heater result icons display correctly.
  • Ambrosia loadout mode checks recognize all languages seen during the page session and avoid repeatedly forcing full saves on unpatched games.
  • AutoSing answers dialogs without flashes on unpatched games, can start from inside an Exalt after asking to leave, and no longer shows a false bookmarklet patch warning.
  • Starting AutoSing waits for the previous run to finish; Load from file and AutoSing no longer leave GDS disabled.
  • Fixed AutoSing’s quark-only export at the end of a singularity.
  • Numbers read from the game follow the browser’s locale, including French and German formats.
  • Heater Hyperflux builds respect the owned Blueberry budget, and their Effect tooltip explains the value.
  • Opening the icon picker no longer disables GDS, and minibars return when GDS resumes.
  • Promo-code uses refresh after Add x10 and Auto-Loadout Time.
  • AutoSing stops when a cloud or Steam-cloud save is loaded; entering and leaving an Exalt no longer flashes Buildings at every singularity.
  • Hepteract quick expand and its ratio line use exact owned balances and capacity.
  • The first recorded AutoSing singularity no longer understates Golden Quark gain or overstates elapsed time.
  • Stopping AutoSing preserves the game’s copy-to-clipboard setting.
  • Corrected salvage, campaign and corruption factors in ascension score, and Speed/Duplication rune bonus calculations; talisman stats refresh after loading a new save.
  • Removed spurious Hepteract warnings.
  • Distributor icons return after reloading Steam with the forge panel open.
  • Ambrosia imports use and load the active or guessed slot after page and save loads; Auto-Loadout restores that slot even when the game marks none.
  • The Ambrosia quickbar works when enabled after load, and Auto-Loadout works even if the bar was disabled at startup.
  • Stacked header modules retain their order when disabled and enabled; enabling a module in the tray tells you where to find it.
  • Heater Exalt 10 scores bar rewards as time and displays the Exalt on its results.
  • Browser loaders automatically reload if the game starts first; missing game patches produce visible notices and unaffected features keep working.
  • New paged game-header loadout modules receive custom icons, Ambrosia active-slot borders and corruption levels.
  • Header modules no longer move one slot right after each reload; the icon picker has a Close button and shows its selection border over active-slot borders.
  • Heater No Quark Upgrades follows the chosen Exalt, which is displayed by name, with a warning if it differs from the export.
  • Best-economy Purple builds show Maxed when every bar-income upgrade is affordable.
  • Purple Honey income uses the correct icon, and moving the top stats row to the bottom leaves a smaller gap.
  • Heater exports and calculations treat shop upgrades locked by Exalt rewards or No Quark Upgrades as level zero.
  • Platonic upgrade timers distinguish Ready after ascending, unestimated Offerings/Obtainium and Exalt 7 overtime, and handle zero-gain ascensions.

Notes

  • This Live release includes the cumulative Dev features through 2.14.5-dev12, as well as Live header controls. Notes compare it with Live 2.14.5.

v2.12.2 Live

2026-04-25

Contributors: maenhiir, Ferlieloi, Core, loader3229

Dev → Live Includes changes merged from Dev. View merge

Added

  • Added AutoSing: repeat singularities at a chosen farming target using editable strategies; targets above the highest unlocked singularity fall back to the highest available.
  • Create, edit, delete, import and export strategies. Bundled strategies load automatically, and newly created or imported strategies become selected. Migrate & Save All updates saved user strategies for compatibility.
  • Strategies have named corruption loadouts, phase-specific choices and an editable AOAG-unlocked phase.
  • The strategy editor supports step comments, drag-and-drop action ordering and a draggable insertion marker; its windows can be resized.
  • Conditional jumps compare challenge completions or a stored Challenge 15 score, including very large scores, with movable jump targets and configurable C15 improvement multipliers.
  • Challenge steps set completion goals, waits before and inside the challenge, and maximum times; C1–10 actions can repeat until no more completions arrive within the chosen time.
  • Choose separate pre-AOAG Cube, post-AOAG Cube, Quark, Obtainium, Offering and Luck loadouts, and load them from strategy actions.
  • Strategy actions can ascend, leave challenges, sacrifice ants, cleanse or reapply corruptions, load ant-speed corruptions and max Challenges 11–14.
  • Strategy actions can toggle auto-challenges, ant sacrifice, auto-ascend and each Hepteract or Orb auto-buy; explicit actions can buy AOAG, restart or stop AutoSing.
  • AutoSing detects Antiquities unlocking, interrupts the current phase and runs the strategy’s AOAG and final sequences before the next singularity.
  • Added Pause/Resume, Restart Singularity and immediate Stop controls, plus a review mode that keeps the dashboard open after stopping.
  • Finish & Stop completes the current singularity push, maxes Challenges 11–14 and returns to the Luck loadout before handing control back.
  • The AutoSing dashboard shows the farming target, highest singularity, strategy, loadout order, current step and phase, plus Challenge 15 score and variation.
  • AutoSing statistics include per-phase timing and full-session totals, minima, maxima and rates for singularity time and Quark/Golden Quark gains; the initial target teleport is excluded.
  • Added timing and gain charts, dotted raw lines, solid averages and CSV export. Chart history is limited while session totals keep accumulating. Detailed data can be shown or hidden, and Advanced Data Collection controls collection of step details.
  • AutoSing preparation exposes cube-opening and tesseract auto-buy percentages and challenge start, enter and exit timers, and enables the game automation required by the run.
  • AutoSing temporarily disables expensive mod features and periodic GDS updates, refreshes game data when needed and restores the affected mod settings after stopping.
  • AutoSing uses Add/Time codes with the Luck loadout at startup and exports a save after its final phase.
  • AutoSing warns about low progression, rejects starts inside an Exalt and stops with a warning if required loadout controls are missing.
  • Added a Fix Exalt Bug recovery button to the mod panel.
  • Added an Automation quickbar for grouped building, rune, research, challenge, cube, ant-sacrifice and ascension controls, including an overall automation toggle and mixed-state feedback.
  • Added a Corruption quickbar with current/next levels and matching-loadout borders. Alt-click assigns an in-game image to a slot; right-click clears it.
  • Added an Events quickbar showing Happy Hour count and Lotus status, with event-end times on hover.
  • Added settings to hide maxed Golden Quark and Octeract upgrades.
  • Added a Golden Quark distributor with saved allocation ratios, purchase status and allocation that accounts for Golden Quarks already invested.
  • Added Add x10 beside the promo-code controls.
  • Quick Import reads up to 16 Ambrosia loadouts from clipboard lines, reports skipped or failed imports and restores the previously active slot.
  • An Ambrosia icon hint explains dragging icons onto slots and right-clicking to clear them.
  • Added Hide vanilla tabs and an option to auto-confirm game pop-ups for Tampermonkey players.
  • Added Copy Log; the log retains up to 5,000 lines instead of 100.

Changed

  • Enabled quickbars and Ambrosia minibars share a managed header row; hover controls on the HS icon provide quick access and quickbar visibility toggles.
  • Talisman fragments get a separate Cycle BUY button, leaving the game’s Buy All available. It shows the next fragment in its color, resets after three seconds and can be disabled.
  • Heater exports split long clipboard data into spreadsheet-sized lines and pad two-part exports to fill three cells.
  • AFK Swapper gains separate Octeract/Bar Points, Blue Luck and Red Luck loadouts and accounts for Brick of Lead and the updated game calculations.
  • Settings use a compact two-row tab layout with inline strategy buttons and clearer UI/debug grouping.
  • Version checks use the configured repository’s GitHub tags rather than the retired original version service.

Fixed

  • Ambrosia loadout highlighting is reconstructed from the loaded save; loadout dropdowns show unlocked slots with the correct icons.
  • Ambrosia calculations and Heater exports account for PseudoCoin upgrades, personal Quark bonuses, Horseshoe/rune/inscription effects and free Ambrosia levels.
  • Updated calculations for the game’s renamed Golden Quark, Octeract and Hepteract save fields, red-Ambrosia luck, effective singularity, the shop accelerator and red-Ambrosia Blueberry upgrades.
  • Changed enabled states and numeric, text and dropdown values persist immediately, including programmatic loadout selections.
  • Updated the browser loader for the game’s bundle and added a Tampermonkey installation bridge.
Sources

v2.8.0 Original

2025-05-21

Contributors: ahvonenj

Added

  • Added an Ambrosia Heater export in the Tools tab. It copies an enhanced save string with mod-calculated data for use in the Heater.
